answer_1.quote: We fine-tune with IIW data and evaluate generated descriptions ... Human SxS evaluations ... to compare our human annotations to prior work (e.g., DCI, DOCCI, GPT-4V).

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU, ROUGE, CIDEr, BERTScore, and BLEURT ... as automatic metrics to evaluate the generated outputs.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human SxS evaluations ... rating the descriptions on Comprehensiveness, Specificity, Hallucinations, TLDR quality, and Human-Likeness.
answer_4.guideline: Raters compare two descriptions side‑by‑side and assign a rating on five criteria: Comprehensiveness, Specificity, Hallucinations, TLDR quality, Human‑Likeness.
